select count(*) from base_treatment_process where patient_id = #{patientId} and appointment_id is not null

select count(*) from base_treatment_process where patient_id = #{patientId} and appointment_id is not null and registered_id is null and CONCAT(date_format(appoint_start_time,'%Y-%m-%d'),' 23:59:59') < NOW() and appoint_status != 2

select btp.appointment_id as appointmentId,btp.registered_id as registeredId,btp.treatment_id as treatmentId,btp.org_id as orgId,btp.patient_id as patientId, btp.treat_status as treatStatus,btp.treat_type as treatType,btp.appoint_status as appointStatus, btp.appoint_dentist_id as appointDentistId,btp.appoint_start_time as appointStartTime, btp.appoint_duration as appointSuration,btp.appoint_modify_time as appointModifyTime,btp.appoint_content as appointContent,btp.registered_dentist_id as registeredDentistId, btp.registered_time as registeredTime,btp.treat_start_time as treatStartTime,btp.treat_end_time as treatEndTime,btp.assistant_1 as assistant1,btp.assistant_2 as assistant2, btp.assistant_3 as assistant3, bp.name as patientName, bp.gender, appointDentistNameBe.employee_name as appointDentistName, regDentistNameBe.employee_name as regDentistName from base_treatment_process btp left join base_patient bp on bp.patient_id = btp.patient_id left join base_employee appointDentistNameBe on appointDentistNameBe.user_id = btp.appoint_dentist_id left join base_employee regDentistNameBe on regDentistNameBe.user_id = btp.registered_dentist_id
btp.appoint_status < 2
and #{dentistId} in (btp.appoint_dentist_id,btp.registered_dentist_id)
and btp.org_id = #{orgId}
and (date_format(btp.appoint_start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') in (date_format(#{currentDate},'%Y-%m-%d')) or date_format(btp.treat_start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') in (date_format(#{currentDate},'%Y-%m-%d')))
